READ_THIS_FIRST.instruction_for_ai: DO NOT calculate totals from individual activities. Use the pre-calculated values in 'summary', 'weekly_summary', and 'derived_metrics' sections below. These are already computed accurately from the API data.
READ_THIS_FIRST.display_formatting: For durations and sleep, always display the '_formatted' fields (e.g., sleep_formatted, duration_formatted, total_training_formatted) instead of converting decimal '_hours' values. The formatted fields are pre-calculated from raw seconds and avoid rounding errors.
READ_THIS_FIRST.extended_data_note: ACWR and baselines calculated from 28 days of data
READ_THIS_FIRST.capability_metrics_note: The 'capability' block in derived_metrics contains durability trend (aggregate decoupling 7d/28d), efficiency factor trend (aggregate EF 7d/28d), HRRc trend (heart rate recovery 7d/28d), TID comparison (7d vs 28d distribution drift), power curve delta (MMP shift at anchor durations across 28d windows — energy system adaptation direction), HR curve delta (max sustained HR shift at anchor durations — cardiac adaptation, cross-sport), sustainability profile (per-sport power/HR sustainability table for race estimation — 42d window, sport-filtered), and DFA a1 profile (per-session non-linear HRV index from AlphaHRV Connect IQ field — latest_session + trailing_by_sport with crossing-band LT1/LT2 estimates). These measure HOW the athlete expresses fitness, not just load. Use these for coaching context alongside traditional load metrics. Durability and EF trend direction matters more than absolute values. HRRc is display only — higher = better parasympathetic recovery. Power curve delta rotation_index reveals whether gains are sprint-biased (positive) or endurance-biased (negative). HR curve delta is ambiguous — rising max sustained HR may indicate fitness or fatigue; cross-reference with resting HRV/HR and RPE. Sustainability profile provides race estimation lookup: actual MMP, Coggan predicted (cycling only), CP/W' model (cycling only), model_divergence_pct (actual vs CP — divergence IS the coaching signal). CP/W' is primary for durations ≤20min; Coggan duration factors are the established reference for ≥60min. Source flag (observed_outdoor/observed_indoor) matters for cycling race estimation — indoor MMP is typically 3-5% lower. DFA a1 profile: thresholds (1.0 ≈ LT1, 0.5 ≈ LT2) cycling-validated only — non-cycling sports get rollups but validated=False. Crossing-band estimates: HR is pooled across all sessions; watts are split by environment for cycling (watts_outdoor, watts_indoor with per-environment n_sessions) — compare watts_outdoor against ftp, watts_indoor against ftp_indoor. Non-cycling sports keep pooled watts. Estimates are provisional at confidence='low' (suppressed for calibration delta surfacing) and usable at 'moderate' or 'high'. DFA a1 is a Tier-2 interpretive signal — does NOT enter readiness P0–P3 ladder, does NOT auto-update dossier zones; surfaces calibration deltas only. Quality gate: refuse to interpret when latest_session.sufficient=false or trailing confidence=null. See SECTION_11.md DFA a1 Protocol for full interpretation rules.
READ_THIS_FIRST.readiness_decision_note: The 'readiness_decision' block contains a pre-computed go/modify/skip recommendation with priority level (P0=safety, P1=overload, P2=fatigue, P3=green), individual signal statuses, phase-adjusted thresholds, and structured modification guidance. Use this as the baseline for pre-workout recommendations. Override with explanation in the coach note if the AI's contextual judgment disagrees.

wellness_field_scales.note: All categorical wellness fields use a 1-4 positional scale where 1 = best state, 4 = worst state. Labels differ per field but direction is consistent. Fields are null when not reported.
wellness_field_scales.menstrual: menstrual_phase and menstrual_phase_predicted are not on the 1-4 scale. Values: PERIOD, FOLLICULAR, OVULATION, LUTEAL, etc.

durability.reliability_note: insufficient qualifying sessions for alert evaluation: 7d N=1 (min 3), 28d N=3 (min 5)
durability.note: Steady-state power sessions only (VI <= 1.05, VI > 0, >= 90min, power data). Negative decoupling = strong durability. Trend compares 7d vs 28d mean (+/-1% = stable). Alerts require N28>=5 (alarm) or N7>=3 AND N28>=5 (declining warning) for statistical reliability.

efficiency_factor.note: Steady-state cycling sessions only (VI <= 1.05, VI > 0, >= 20min, power+HR data). Rising EF = improving aerobic efficiency. Compare like-for-like sessions only — EF varies with intensity. Trend compares 7d vs 28d mean (+/-0.03 = stable).

hrrc.note: HRRc = heart rate recovery (largest 60s HR drop in bpm after exceeding threshold HR for >1 min). Higher = better parasympathetic recovery. Null when threshold not reached, recording stopped before cooldown, or no HR data. Trend: 7d mean vs 28d mean, >10% = meaningful (min 1 session/7d, 3 sessions/28d). Display only — not wired into readiness_decision signals.

tid_comparison.note: Compares 7d vs 28d Seiler TID to detect distribution shifts. pi_delta positive = more polarized acutely.

power_curve_delta.note: Compares MMP at 5 anchor durations (5s neuromuscular, 60s anaerobic, 300s MAP, 1200s threshold, 3600s endurance) across two 28d windows. rotation_index = mean(5s,60s pct_change) - mean(1200s,3600s pct_change). Positive = sprint-biased gains, negative = endurance-biased. 300s excluded from rotation (transitional). Null when either window has fewer than 3 valid anchor durations.

hr_curve_delta.note: Compares max sustained HR at 4 anchor durations (60s anaerobic ceiling, 300s VO2max HR, 1200s threshold HR, 3600s endurance HR) across two 28d windows. rotation_index = mean(60s,300s pct_change) - mean(1200s,3600s pct_change). Positive = intensity-biased HR shift, negative = endurance-biased. No sport filter — HR is cross-sport physiological (dominated by hardest efforts). IMPORTANT: rising max sustained HR is ambiguous — may indicate improved cardiac output (good) or accumulated fatigue/dehydration/heat (bad). Cross-reference with resting HRV, resting HR, RPE, and environmental context before interpreting. Null when either window has fewer than 3 valid anchor durations.

cycling.model_trust_note: CP/W' model (P=CP+W'/t) is primary for durations ≤20min where W' contribution is meaningful. Coggan duration factors (Allen & Coggan, 3rd ed.) are the established reference for ≥60min. 30min is the crossover zone where both apply. model_divergence_pct = (actual - CP_model) / CP_model × 100. Positive divergence at short durations may indicate strong anaerobic capacity or stale W' value. Indoor MMP is typically 3-5% lower than outdoor (cooling, motivation) — source flag indicates which environment produced each anchor.

planned_workouts.name: P2 W39 - Home Strength Viability Hold 35min
planned_workouts.description:
Macro phase: Phase 2 — Aerobic base and strength foundation (2026 W37–W44).

Section 11 basis: individualized home-strength foundation; pull-up bar and bodyweight only.
Adaptation target: retain a conservative strength dose while consolidating stress onto Thursday's hard day during the three-hard-day trial.

Perform this after the VO2 ride, as one combined hard-day block rather than on Wednesday. Hold the prior dose; do not progress lower-body repetitions during the frequency trial. Stop if movement quality is abnormal after cycling.

Warm-up 5 minutes. Then use controlled technique and normal rests:
- Reverse lunge: 2 x 8 each side
- Single-leg hip hinge: 2 x 8 each side
- Hamstring walkout: 2 x 6
- Push-up: 2 x 8–15, stop with at least 3 RIR
- Pull-up or controlled negative: 3 submaximal sets, stop with at least 3 RIR
- Single-leg calf raise: 2 x 12 each side
- Side plank: 2 x 20–30 seconds each side

Record completed repetitions, hardest-set RIR, movement quality and next-day soreness. This is a hold, not a progression. Omit it if the VO2 session leaves abnormal coordination or mechanics; do not move it to Friday.

planned_workouts.name: P2 W39 HARD 2/3 - Indoor ERG VO2 Completion 5x3 at 115% 70min
planned_workouts.description:
Macro phase: Phase 2 — Aerobic base and strength foundation (2026 W37–W44).

Section 11 basis: Custom continuous VO2 introduction adapted from VO2-1.
Adaptation target: complete the fifth repetition at the established power after four controlled W38 repetitions; increase completion, not power or total planned repetitions.

Accepted indoor setting is 254 W. W38 produced four completed three-minute efforts at 291/294/291/291 W with stable cadence and no power fade. Interval HR maxima rose 167/172/177/176 bpm; whole-session RPE was 9 and Feel was 3, and the fifth repetition was omitted because the near-maximal cardiovascular sensation was unfamiliar. The 12 completed hard minutes are an accepted introductory VO2 dose, but the response blocks the previously proposed 6x3 progression. W39 therefore remains five three-minute efforts at one exact 115% ERG target, approximately 292 W. Completing the fifth repetition is the progression from W38. Do not raise power or add a sixth repetition. Proceed to rep five only when the first four remain mechanically controlled and there is no chest pain, dizziness, unusual palpitation or disproportionate breathlessness; otherwise hold at four, reduce, or switch to aerobic riding. Final permission still depends on clean 24–48-hour recovery and current readiness.

- 5m 65% FTP
- 5m 75% FTP
- 1m 95% FTP
- 4m 50% FTP
- 3m 115% FTP
- 3m 50% FTP
- 3m 115% FTP

- 3m 115% FTP
- 3m 50% FTP
- 3m 115% FTP
- 3m 50% FTP
- 3m 115% FTP
- 13m 65% FTP

Use ERG with strong cooling and steady cadence; do not raise power mid-session. If Tuesday threshold produced RPE above 8, material fade, abnormal soreness, or readiness is adverse, replace this with 60 minutes aerobic at one exact 65% FTP target. Log actual power, HR after oxygen kinetics rise, cadence, RPE/Feel and 24–48-hour recovery.
Trial gate: this is the second hard day in the athlete-requested Tuesday/Thursday/Saturday trial. Use the current Section 11 readiness decision plus new illness, sleep, soreness, pain, coordination and warm-up response. Reduce the work duration or use easy aerobic riding if execution is abnormal; that is dose control, not non-adherence.

planned_workouts.name: P2 W39 - Easy Run — Impact Maintenance 45min
planned_workouts.description:
Macro phase: Phase 2 — Aerobic base and strength foundation (2026 W37–W44).

Section 11 basis: individualized secondary-sport impact maintenance.
Adaptation target: preserve impact familiarity without competing with cycling development.

Execution: 5-minute easy warm-up, 35 minutes at approximately 6:25–6:55/km on flat predictable terrain, then 5-minute easy cool-down. Keep RPE 2–3 and conversational throughout.
Start only with normal walking/stairs, no pain at rest and no focal shin/ankle tenderness. Stop for focal or increasing pain, pain above 2/10, or gait change.
This preserves general impact tolerance, not half-marathon-specific durability. Do not add cycling if shortened or skipped.
Readiness gate: use the current Section 11 readiness decision plus new athlete-reported illness, sleep, soreness, pain, coordination and in-session response. Athlete-reported adverse state overrides favorable modeled metrics. Do not repay reduced or missed work.

planned_workouts.name: P2 W39 HARD 3/3 - Indoor ERG Sweet Spot 2x25 at 229W 75min
planned_workouts.description:
Macro phase: Phase 2 — Aerobic base and strength foundation (2026 W37–W44).

Section 11 basis: SS-1 Sustained Sweet Spot Blocks, adapted to 2 x 25 minutes as the controlled third hard day of the three-hard-day trial.
Adaptation target: progress the Saturday sustained-power dose from W38 2 x 20 at the same indoor power, conditional on clean execution and Sunday recovery.

Progression gate: use this 2 x 25 dose only if W38 Saturday 2 x 20 and the following strict-Z2 Sunday are completed with stable power/cadence, RPE no higher than 8 and clean recovery; otherwise repeat 2 x 20.

GARMIN / MYWHOOSH ERG — exact steady steps at retained indoor FTP 254 W:
WARM-UP
- 2m at 127 W (50%)
- 2m at 140 W (55%)
- 2m at 152 W (60%)
- 2m at 165 W (65%)
- 2m at 178 W (70%)

WORK
- 25m at 229 W (90%)
- 5m at 127 W (50%)
- 25m at 229 W (90%)

COOLDOWN
- 2m at 152 W (60%)
- 2m at 147 W (58%)
- 2m at 140 W (55%)
- 2m at 132 W (52%)
- 2m at 127 W (50%)

RPE target 7–8. Maintain stable cadence and do not raise the final block. Fuel 60 g carbohydrate during the ride.

Trial gate: this is the third hard day in the athlete-requested Tuesday/Thursday/Saturday trial. Use the current Section 11 readiness decision plus new illness, sleep, soreness, pain, coordination and warm-up response. Reduce the work duration or use easy aerobic riding if execution is abnormal; that is dose control, not non-adherence. Sunday remains strictly aerobic with no tempo finish.

planned_workouts.name: P2 W39 - Long Aerobic Durability 3h00
planned_workouts.description:
Macro phase: Phase 2 — Aerobic base and strength foundation (2026 W37–W44).

Section 11 basis: AE-3 Long Durability Ride.
Adaptation target: aerobic durability, fueling execution and repeatable long-ride tolerance.
Three hours restores the already successful normal-week durability dose (2026-08-23: 3.03 h, VI 1.018, 2.28% eligible decoupling, RPE 2, Feel 1) after the Harz exception; it does not progress from the excursion.

- 10m 55-65% FTP
- 160m 62-72% FTP
- 10m 50-60% FTP

Outdoor encoding uses percentage ranges against the provisional outdoor FTP of 265 W. Keep RPE 2–3, avoid tempo finishes and repeated threshold climbing, and let safety override power. Fuel 60–90 g carbohydrate/hour, using 90 g/h when practicing the established event strategy; start early. Record intake, RPE/Feel and next-day response.
Readiness gate: use the current Section 11 readiness decision plus new athlete-reported illness, sleep, soreness, pain, coordination and in-session response. Athlete-reported adverse state overrides favorable modeled metrics. Do not repay reduced or missed work.

Three-hard-day trial: keep this genuinely Z2 after Saturday sweet spot. It does not count as hard when executed within the prescribed aerobic range; no tempo finish.

planned_workouts.name: P2 W41 SCAFFOLD — Loading 1 / Three-Hard-Day Trial Resumption
planned_workouts.description_preview:
Macro phase: Phase 2 — Aerobic base and strength foundation (2026 W37–W44).
Status: provisional weekly architecture scaffold only — not an exact workout prescription. No hours or training load are assigned by this note.
Architecture: Loading week 1 of the W41–W44 3:1 block. Use the executed W38–W39 trial evidence plus W40 consolidation response to decide whether Tuesday/Thursday/Saturday three-hard-day cycling resumes. If supportive, preserve at least 48 hours between the complementary threshold, VO2/high-aerobic and controlled sweet-spot/tempo roles, one genuinely Z2 long ride, home-first strength and easy impact maintenance around the normal approximately 8-hour cycling-plus-running target, with strength additional; eight hours is not a cap, floor or filler obligation. If evidence is adverse, modify the failing dose or return to two hard days rather than forcing the label.
